title: Beverly hovering metallic object

tellings.quote: Beverly, Massachusetts, 1966. Uh, nine witnesses, two law enforcement officers see a metallic platelike object

plain: In 1966 in Beverly, Massachusetts, nine witnesses, two of them police officers, are said to have seen a metallic object shaped like a plate. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff cites the case briefly, without naming a source, as an example of a sighting backed by several credible witnesses.
